Only the investment areas listed in Annex
aw hereof, also known as the Foreign Investment Negative
List, shall be reserved to Philippine Nationals. The extent
of foreign equity participation in these areas shall be
limited to percentages indicated in the List.
Any Amendment to the list shall only be
made once every two years, pursuant to section 8 of the FIA
